question: In the Sn-incorporated GST terahertz study, by what factor did the 1 THz conductivity of undoped GST rise from annealing at 150 °C to annealing at 250 °C?
rendered:
The conductivity of undoped GST at 1 THz is given in Table 1 of the document as 20.29 at 150 °C and 49.43 at 250 °C. 

To find the factor by which the conductivity rose, divide the conductivity at 250 °C by the conductivity at 150 °C: 

49.43 / 20.29 ≈ 2.44
